titulo_es: The particle бы and the condition
intro: Бы forms hypothetical or desired expressions and is usually accompanied by the past: бы поехал, если бы было время.

bloques.titulo: Бы forms hypothetical or desired expressions and is usually accompanied by the past: бы поехал, если бы было время.
texto: Бы forms hypothetical or desired expressions and is usually accompanied by the past: бы поехал, если бы было время.
The particle can go next to the verb or after another word with emphasis; it does not mark the real past in these phrases.

frases.ru: Если бы у нас было больше времени, мы посетили бы музей.
frases.es: Si tuviéramos más tiempo, visitaríamos el museo.
frases.en: If we had more time, we'd visit the museum.

frases.ru: Я бы проверил документ ещё раз.
frases.es: Yo revisaría el documento una vez más.
frases.en: I'd check the document once more.

opciones.explicacion: Бы presents an imagined possibility, not a confirmed fact.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.
